title: BUGFIX — Achiri engage/reengage: add MIN_USER_ID=100000 to filter fake IDs like 99999
rationale: logs/achiri-daily-engage-error.log and logs/achiri-reengage-error.log show 400 'chat not found' errors from Telegram. The scripts already have REAL_USER_REGEX=/^-?\d+$/ (Sprint 1416/1417) to filter out e2e-test-* IDs, but this misses low numeric IDs like '99999' (workspace/achiri/memory/99999.jsonl = test user). Real Telegram user IDs are always ≥ 1,000,000 (6001921477 is a real user). Add MIN_USER_ID = 100_000 check after the regex filter in both scripts.
success_criteria: User '99999' is filtered out before sending
Real user '6001921477' is NOT filtered out
Error logs stop showing 400 'chat not found' for test user IDs

tasks.description: daily-engagement.ts + achiri-reengage.ts: after REAL_USER_REGEX filter, add const MIN_USER_ID = 100_000; filter that drops numeric IDs < MIN_USER_ID. Log how many were filtered.
